question: The Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative (BFHI) Ten Steps to Successful Breastfeeding requires that newborns be placed in skin-to-skin contact with their mother immediately after birth and that breastfeeding be initiated within the first hour of life.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. BFHI Step 4 requires immediate skin-to-skin contact and Step 5 specifies breastfeeding initiation within the first hour of life — both are mandatory for Baby-Friendly Hospital designation.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Steps 4 and 5 of the BFHI Ten Steps mandate immediate skin-to-skin contact after birth and initiation of breastfeeding within the first hour (early initiation), together forming the foundation of the Baby-Friendly approach.
